 Load Cells and Sensors 
Our high quality load cells and sensors are used for materials testing and force measurement all over the world.
The full bridge load cells and sensors provide high precision measurements that ensure adherence to the international standards. 
 HLC Series Load Cells 
 Full bridge strain gauged load cells compatible with the floor standing LR Plus Series materials testing machines. 
 Keep Reading 
 XLC Series Load Cells 
 Full bridge strain gauged load cells compatible with the LR Plus and EZ Series bench mounted materials testing machines. 
 Keep Reading 
 YLC Series Load Cells 
 These load cells are compatible with the LS Series test machines, the TA1 texture analyser and the FT1 friction tester. 
 Keep Reading 
 CLC Series Load Cells 
 Full bridge strain gauged load cells compatible with the CS Series force measurement testers. 
 Keep Reading 
 AFM/AQM External loadcell and torque transducer 
 The external sensors: AFM external load cell, and the AQM external torque transducer, can be used together with our force gauge DFS3 to offer ultimate flexibility when performing different types of tests in various applications without having to constantly change settings. 
 Keep Reading 
 SLC Series Load Cells 
 Full bridge strain gauged load cells compatible with the DFS-R-ND Series digital force gauge. 
 Keep Reading 
 TLC Series Load Cells 
 Full bridge strain gauged load cells compatible with the obsolete TCD digital force testers. 
 Keep Reading 
 STS Series Torque Load Cells 
 The STS Series torque load cells are full bridge strain gauged load cells used exclusively with the DFS-R-ND Series torque gauges.
